								</li>
							</ul>
							<div id="replyArea" class="reply_wrap">
								<ul class="reply" id="comment_creat" style="list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0">
									
								</ul>
							</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
<script>
	var commentCheckEl = document.getElementById("commentChecked");
	commentCheckEl.addEventListener("click", (event => {
		var checked = event.target.checked;
		if(checked){
			document.getElementById("replySection").style.display = "";
		} else {
			document.getElementById("replySection").style.display = "none";
		}
	}));
</script>
